headline: Authorities Identify Suspect Following Fatal Washington DC Shooting
seoTitle: Suspect Identified in Fatal DC Shooting
metaDescription: Police in Washington DC have identified the suspect in a fatal gym shooting that left one person dead and four others injured in Logan Circle.
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials confirmed the suspect died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.
The shooting incident occurred at a gym located in the Logan Circle neighborhood.
One person was killed and four others sustained injuries during the event.
aiContextParagraph: On November 12, 2026, a shooting incident took place at a fitness facility in the Logan Circle neighborhood of Northwest Washington, DC, approximately one mile from the White House. Following the arrival of law enforcement, authorities identified the suspect as 55-year-old Matt Wade Lambert. Police reported that Lambert died at the scene from a self-inflicted gunshot wound. The incident resulted in the death of one individual and left four others wounded. Local authorities held a press conference to provide updates on the investigation, confirming the identities of both the suspect and the deceased victim. The event triggered significant media coverage across multiple international and domestic outlets as investigators worked to secure the scene and determine the circumstances surrounding the violence.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved a high viral activity score due to rapid, widespread coverage from nine independent media outlets reporting on the incident in the US capital.
